title.purpose: Names the command palette for screen readers.

input.label.purpose: Names the palette's text box for screen readers.

input.placeholder.purpose: Hint inside the palette's text box.
input.placeholder.where: Command palette, text box, while empty.

list.label.purpose: Names the palette's list of commands for screen readers.

empty.purpose: Says no command matches what was typed.
empty.where: Command palette, under the text box, when the list is empty.

goTo.purpose: A command that opens a screen; {{name}} is the screen's name.
goTo.where: Command palette, one row per screen (Go to Library).

searchAllMusic.purpose: A command that opens All music with the cursor in its search box.

openSettings.purpose: A command that opens the Settings screen. Always listed.

theme.purpose: A command that switches the theme; {{name}} is the theme (Dark or Light). Listed only for the theme not in use.
